scenes.headline: 好みを、別々に保存
scenes.communicates: Seven fictional preferences were stored as given (infer=False) into one store, scoped by user: aya 4, ken 3.
scenes.enters: people, empty store, drawer and tray are already drawn
scenes.action: tiles A01-A04 fly from aya into the teal section and K01-K03 from ken into the purple section; count badges count up to the M01 get_all counts
scenes.exits: all seven tiles in place; tray reads the stored counts
labels: あや4件・けん3件を保存

scenes.headline: 同じ問い、違う好み
scenes.communicates: The same query with filters.user_id returns only that user's records; these are two separately recorded searches, not a live chat.
scenes.enters: bubble shows the short query 見せ方は？
scenes.action: 5.4s funnel あやだけ routes into the teal section; M02 results A01, A02, A03 get rank marks and copies travel to the tray in that order. 8.2s funnel けんだけ routes into the purple section; M03 results K02, K01, K03 follow. The section outside the filter steps back.
scenes.exits: ken's copies leave the tray at 11s
limits: Ranks only; Mem0 scores are ranking values, not probabilities
user_id filtering is selection scope, not authentication

scenes.headline: 20秒から、30秒へ
scenes.communicates: An explicit Memory.update changed A02 in place: same ID, 20 seconds became 30 seconds.
scenes.enters: bubble IDで更新; A02 turns warm and shows its actual ID prefix
scenes.action: 12.6-13.3s the digits in the same A02 tile roll from the M05 before value to the after value; tag 20→30; drawer line A02 追加→更新 (M05 history). 14.2s the M04/M05 query 動画は？ with あや＋動画 returns A02, now 無音30秒
scenes.exits: the A02 copy leaves the tray at 17s
limits: The wrapper called update explicitly; Mem0 did not revise the preference by itself

scenes.headline: 仮の予定を、一覧から外す
scenes.communicates: Deleting A04 removes it from get/get_all/search; the ADD and DELETE history rows remain.
scenes.enters: bubble IDで削除; A04 gets a 削除 tag
scenes.action: 18.0-19.3s the same A04 tile moves out of the active store into the history drawer and becomes dashed (一覧の外); aya count goes from the M01 count to the M06 count; drawer line A04 追加→削除; tray shows get A04 → なし
scenes.exits: A04 stays visible in the drawer for the rest of the film
limits: No physical erasure or history deletion is claimed

scenes.headline: 開き直しても、30秒
scenes.communicates: A fresh Python process reopened the same closed Qdrant/SQLite store: A02 is still 30 seconds with the same ID, A04 is absent from the active lists, aya 3 and ken 3.
scenes.enters: bubble 別プロセス; the store dims with 閉じる
scenes.action: the tab restart mark turns and the tab reads 同じ保存先; 別プロセスで開く; the store brightens with the same tiles; 24.8s 動画は？ あや＋動画 returns A02 (M07 search); A02 tag 30秒のまま; count badges pulse at the M07 counts
scenes.exits: route, A02 copy and tags stay
limits: This depicts the recorded worker process; it is not a browser or simulated restart

scenes.headline: 覚えて、引き出す
scenes.communicates: The whole connected picture is held with the actual-record save CTA.
scenes.action: CTA 記録をJSONで保存 fades in above the footer; nothing else moves
limits: Saved results only, infer=False, no LLM call, no live inference, no authenticated isolation claim

scope: Silent: no audio track, narration, transcript or audio controls. K02's text 「ナレーション付き・60秒程度」 is a fictional stored preference shown as 語り60秒, not narration in this film.
Short headings on tiles are condensed from the stored sentences; the full sentences are in outputs/memory-run.json and comparison.html.
The film does not show M01 calls one by one, M04 on its own, or M08; those remain in comparison.html#M01, #M04 and #M08.
The Mem0 skill mainly covers the hosted Platform and routes self-hosted use to client/python.md; the run used only the OSS Memory class without API keys, login, mem0 init, plugins or network.
